name: The Cost To Follow Jesus
overview: Following Jesus demands a profound commitment marked by self-denial and a willingness to bear one's cross, as He clearly instructs in Mark 8:34 and Luke 9:23. Jesus exemplifies this cost Himself, living without earthly security or comfort (Matthew 8:20) and calling His followers to readiness for His unexpected return (Matthew 24:44). The call to discipleship is not to be taken lightly, for those who refuse to carry their cross and follow Him demonstrate unworthiness of Him (Matthew 10:38). This teaching underscores that true discipleship involves surrendering personal ambitions and embracing the hardships of the Christian journey.
